research.angle: While objective wealth did not predict prosocial behavior in children, research across 76 countries shows a consistent positive association between wealth and prosociality.
research.verdict: The evidence contradicts the proposed angle by showing a consistent positive association between wealth and prosociality across various measures and countries.
research.caveat: The studies do not provide specific data on whether these prosocial behaviors occur in secret or anonymous settings.
